evidence: Q1 (rebuild silent-omission): HOLDS - fail-closed. Independently read rebuild_workspace: seeding source = union of the dual-placement registry's declared files and every file in the canonical products/T##/ tree. A canonical-only file (registry missed it) is still copied into the workspace and flagged verified=false (unverified, hash recorded, source noted) - so while the canonical tree exists NO silent omission is possible. A registry entry present at NEITHER the canonical copy NOR the run-dir working copy raises ValueError ('neither ... nor'), which build_package surfaces as a non-zero --package exit (fail-closed packaging, judgement not written). test_2b (registry entry with no source anywhere -> ValueError) and test_2c (canonical missing, working-copy fallback with hash check) pin both branches. The author precheck 'double-source-missing = hard fail' is corroborated.

Q2 (out= matching algorithm): dual-condition CORRECT; residual surfaces are frozen exact-substring semantics (recorded as ADV-1, not blocking). Independently verified the cmd-track out= check runs on the FULL captured output (the 20000-char truncation applies only to the ref-form observation, NOT the cmd out= check - so the truncation surface the card worried about is a non-issue for cmd out=). Encoding is UTF-8 errors=replace (repo console discipline); case-sensitivity and CRLF-sensitivity are the frozen 'single-line exact substring' caliber (v1.5 s11 C11), not an instrument bug - changing them is a prereg change. test_6b (exit matches but out mismatches -> E2, 'claimed output not reproduced') pins the ADV-1 third-state exclusion.
